answer: Who guards the vertex where all roads meet? On this stage, each mask must earn its island alone: a sequential, memory-hard walk that revisits every vertex its operator has already claimed, each step chained like ferrous links no hand can split or pass along. One mask walks 1 vertex; ten masks walk 55, and no parallel cast shortens a chain walked in order. One honest player walks one road, pays one walk, and keeps an honest part.
